chunks: Warn them of that day of pining when all matters will have been settled, though they would still be unaware and unbelieving (of the truth).
ai.seo_question: What is the Day of Regret (Yawm al-Hasrah) mentioned in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of the 'Final Decree' (Qada') where the fate of the righteous and wicked is sealed, serving as a warning to those in spiritual heedlessness. It highlights the tragic irony of the disbelievers' regret arising only when the matter is concluded, a concept often linked to the Day of Judgment or the emergence of the Mahdi. The verse thus emphasizes the finality of divine command and the futility of late repentance for those who remained in disbelief.
